female.underFive: No child under five lives here.

changes.effect: If Manjula has a future child or when neighbours' toddlers reach three, early schooling can build routines that support regular meals and health checks during critical growth years.

changes.factor: Mothers who took iron-folic acid for 180+ days in pregnancy
changes.effect: If Manjula becomes pregnant again, taking iron tablets for six months would protect her health and the baby's birth weight, reducing stunting risk from the start.

changes.factor: Household members covered by health insurance
changes.effect: Without insurance, Manjula avoids costly private care even when her son has stomach upsets. Coverage would let her seek timely treatment for childhood illnesses that undermine growth.
